visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot of a slice of glistening, seared chicken on a wooden cutting board; a tiny animated female character lies on top of the meat. (2) A woman with short black hair and glasses, wearing a green V-neck shirt, stands in a brightly lit kitchen, placing raw chicken and a liquid sauce into a clear plastic vacuum bag. (3) A digital background appears showing a swirling galaxy or nebula; the woman, now a tiny animated version in a space suit, floats in the center. (4) The woman in the kitchen places the vacuum bag into a white, modern electric pot; she later adds two eggs to the water. (5) Close-up shots of the pot's digital interface show settings being adjusted to 64 degrees and 50 minutes. (6) In a black frying pan, chicken pieces are seared until the skin is dark brown and bubbly; a metal spatula is used to flip them. (7) Thick brown sauce bubbles vigorously in the pan. (8) The cooked chicken is sliced on a wooden board. (9) Raw rice, water, and edamame are poured into the white pot. (10) The final dish is assembled in a white bowl with rice, edamame, corn, sliced chicken, a soft-boiled egg, and a drizzle of thick sauce; the tiny avatar appears again by the egg.

The narrator explains the cooking parameters while the music maintains a consistent, joyful energy. The narrator's speech remains rhythmic and clear. (4) More sizzling sounds occur, increasing in percussiveness as liquid is stirred in a pan. A soft 'pop' sound effect is heard. (5) The narrator's tone becomes more enthusiastic as she describes the finished meal. The BGM continues until a final fade-out at the end of the clip.
